description: Searches vacation rentals that are free for the given dates in a place and returns homes with their all-in totals (fees and taxes included), cheapest first, with links and offer_ids for get_quote. For trips without a specific listing in mind.

check_out.description: Check-out date (the morning the traveler leaves), YYYY-MM-DD

infants.description: Guests under 2; they don't count toward capacity. Default 0

limit.description: How many results to return, 1-20. Default 10

location.description: Where to stay: a city, region or neighborhood, e.g. "Lisbon" or "Joshua Tree, California"

max_total.description: Only stays whose all-in total (USD) is at most this

min_bedrooms.description: Only homes with at least this many bedrooms

name: search_stays
title: Search stays
